about: What bcir-cc (the C rail of the verified C compiler, default target x86_64-linux, -I runtime/c) makes of each production unit runtime/c/MEMORY_CLASSIFICATION.txt lists: clean (R1-R18 clean), or blocked, with its first refusal, the construct it is about and the CSUB rung that lifts it. Held exact by tools/c/csub_ratchet.py (docs/research/BCIR_C_SUBSET_AUDIT_2026-11-10.md section 4).
